title: Block safety
statement: Given limits and a state, a skip statement is safe. An assignment is safe when its expression is safe; a store is safe when its address and value expressions are safe and its address lies in the permitted range. A sequence is safe when its first statement is safe in the initial state and its second is safe after the first statement; a conditional is safe when its condition is safe and each branch is safe whenever that branch is selected. While loops and procedure calls are not safe.
